meta.name: The Royal Knowledge and Royal Secret
meta.outline: Verses 1–3: the king of knowledge and the king of secrets; 4–10: how Krishna fills and supports the world without being bound by it; 11–15: the foolish who look down on him, and the great souls who worship him; 16–19: “I am the ritual, the father, the goal”; 20–25: heaven does not last, and each worshipper reaches what they worship; 26–28: a leaf, a flower, a fruit, and offering everything; 29–34: Krishna is the same to all, and no devotee of his is ever lost.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: this most secret thing, to you
you will be freed from what is harmful
verses.tr: Krishna said: Since you do not find fault, I shall tell you this deepest secret: knowledge together with direct experience. Knowing it, you will be freed from all that is harmful.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: This is the king of knowledge and the king of secrets, the greatest purifier. It can be known by direct experience, it is in keeping with dharma, it is very easy to practise, and it lasts for ever.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: to the path of death and rebirth
verses.tr: People who have no faith in this teaching, Arjuna, do not reach me. They return to the path of death and rebirth.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: this whole world is pervaded by me
but I do not rest in them
verses.tr: This whole world is filled by me in my unseen form. All beings rest in me, but I do not rest in them.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्
words: and yet beings do not rest in me
verses.tr: And yet beings do not rest in me. See my divine power! My self brings all beings into existence and supports them, yet does not rest in them.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: just as, always resting in space
verses.tr: Just as the mighty wind, which goes everywhere, always rests in space, so all beings rest in me. Understand this.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: at the end of an age of creation (kalpa)
at the start of the next age
verses.tr: At the end of an age of creation, Arjuna, all beings pass into my nature. At the start of the next age, I send them forth again.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: I send forth again and again
verses.tr: Controlling my own nature, I send forth again and again this whole multitude of beings, which is helpless under nature's power.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय
words: न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति
and those actions do not bind me
seated like one who is not involved
verses.tr: These actions do not bind me, Arjuna. I remain like one who is not involved, unattached to them.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: all that moves and does not move
verses.tr: Under my watch, nature gives birth to everything that moves and everything that does not. This, Arjuna, is why the world keeps turning.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the foolish look down on me
when I take a human body
as the great Lord of all beings
verses.tr: The foolish look down on me when I take a human form. They do not know my higher nature as the great Lord of all beings.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: they have lost their good sense
that deludes, they have taken up
verses.tr: Their hopes, their actions and their knowledge all come to nothing. They have lost their good sense and taken up a fierce and demonic nature that deludes them.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: knowing me as the unchanging source of beings
verses.tr: But the great souls, Arjuna, take shelter in the divine nature. Knowing me as the unchanging source of all beings, they worship me with undivided minds.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: and bowing to me with devotion
they worship, always united with me
verses.tr: Always singing my praise, striving with firm resolve and bowing to me with devotion, they worship me, always united with me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: others too, by the sacrifice of knowledge
verses.tr: Others worship me through the sacrifice of knowledge: as the One, as distinct from themselves, or in my many forms that face in every direction.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: I am the offering to the ancestors
I am the act of offering
verses.tr: I am the ritual and the sacrifice, the offering to the ancestors and the healing herb. I am the mantra, the ghee, the fire and the act of offering.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक् साम यजुरेव च
words: I am the father of this world
and the Rig, Sama and Yajur Vedas
verses.tr: I am the father of this world, its mother, its supporter and its grandfather. I am what is to be known, the purifier, the syllable Om, and the Rig, Sama and Yajur Vedas.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्
verses.tr: I am the goal, the supporter, the master, the witness, the home, the refuge and the friend. I am the beginning and the end, the foundation, the storehouse and the seed that never perishes.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: I hold back the rain and send it down
I am immortality and also death
I am what is and what is not
verses.tr: I give heat. I hold back the rain and I send it down. I am immortality and I am death, Arjuna. I am both what is and what is not.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: those who follow the three Vedas
reaching the pure world of Indra, king of the gods
they enjoy in heaven the divine pleasures of the gods
verses.tr: Those who follow the three Vedas, who drink the soma juice and are cleansed of wrong, worship me with sacrifices and pray to go to heaven. They reach the world of Indra, king of the gods, and there they enjoy the pleasures of the gods.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: having enjoyed that wide world of heaven
when their merit is used up
they enter the world of mortals
so those who follow the way of the three Vedas
wanting pleasures, is what they get
verses.tr: After enjoying that wide world of heaven, they return to the world of mortals when their merit is used up. So those who follow the rituals of the three Vedas out of a wish for pleasure only keep going and coming.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: thinking of me and nothing else
for those who are always united with me
I carry what they lack and protect what they have
verses.tr: For those who worship me thinking of nothing else, and who are always united with me, I bring what they lack and I protect what they have.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: even those devoted to other gods
who worship them full of faith
though not in the right way
verses.tr: Even those who are devoted to other gods and worship them with faith are really worshipping me alone, Arjuna, though not in the right way.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च
words: for I am, of all sacrifices
but they do not know me as I truly am
verses.tr: For I am the one who receives every sacrifice, and I am its lord. But they do not know me as I truly am, and so they fall back.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम्
words: those devoted to the gods go to the gods
those devoted to the ancestors go to the ancestors
those who worship spirits go to the spirits
and those who worship me come to me
verses.tr: Those who are devoted to the gods go to the gods. Those devoted to the ancestors go to the ancestors. Those who worship spirits go to the spirits. And those who worship me come to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति
words: a leaf, a flower, a fruit or water
from one whose heart is pure
verses.tr: If someone offers me a leaf, a flower, a fruit or a little water with devotion, I accept that offering of love from a pure heart.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: do that as an offering to me
verses.tr: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer in sacrifice, whatever you give and whatever discipline you practise, Arjuna, do it as an offering to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: with their good and bad results
in this way you will be freed from the bonds of action
with your mind steady in the yoga of letting go
set free, you will come to me
verses.tr: In this way you will be freed from the bonds of action and from its good and bad results. With your mind steady in this yoga of letting go, you will be set free and will come to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम्
words: I am the same to all beings
न मे द्वेष्यः अस्ति न प्रियः
no one is hateful to me, no one is dear
but those who worship me with devotion
verses.tr: I am the same to all beings. I hate no one and I favour no one. But those who worship me with devotion are in me, and I am in them.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः
words: even if someone of very bad conduct
worships me and no one else
he must be counted as good
for he has made the right decision
verses.tr: Even if a person of very bad conduct worships me with undivided devotion, that person must be counted as good, for they have made the right decision.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति
words: he quickly becomes a person of dharma
verses.tr: Such a person quickly becomes good and finds lasting peace. Arjuna, declare it boldly: my devotee is never lost.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः
स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम्
words: even those who may be of low birth
they too reach the highest goal
verses.tr: Arjuna, all who take refuge in me reach the highest goal: even those thought to be of low birth, and women, traders and labourers too.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: having come to this passing, joyless world
verses.tr: How much more, then, the pure brahmins and the devoted royal sages! Having come into this passing and joyless world, worship me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु
words: you will come to me alone
having united yourself with me in this way
with me as your highest goal
verses.tr: Fix your mind on me, be devoted to me, worship me and bow to me. Uniting yourself with me in this way, with me as your highest goal, you will come to me.
